rationale: Volt-VAR curve designed to inject reactive power at low voltage (0.92-0.98 p.u.) to mitigate voltage sag, and absorb reactive power at high voltage (1.04-1.08 p.u.) to mitigate voltage swell. Curve is strictly increasing in voltage_pu and monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction. All corrected voltages stay within [0.95, 1.05] p.u. limits and reactive power commands stay within inverter capability (80 kvar for t_low and t_high, 60 kvar for t_nom).
